cavity.definition: A hole in a tooth. It forms when acid from plaque weakens the enamel.
cavity.example: The dentist filled my cavity yesterday.

expense_claim.definition: Money you paid for work that the company owes you back. It almost always needs a receipt and a deadline.
expense_claim.example: I submitted the taxi receipts as an expense claim on Friday.

mia_appeal_to_emotion.definition: The replacing of a reason with a feeling, and the treatment of the feeling as the answer.
mia_appeal_to_emotion.example: After everything I have done for this team was an appeal to emotion, not a reason.

police_report.definition: The written record the local police make about a loss or theft. Most embassies require one before issuing any document.
police_report.example: Here is my police report; the reference number is on the first page.
